scientific_integrity: Graph and simplicial complex are explicitly defined. Integral homotopy follows from a completely acyclic finite Morse matching; mod-two chain computation is independent corroboration, not an integral proof. No claim of independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite named-graph result only; exhaustive face-poset certificate is reproducible. No classification of all cubic graphs, no equivariant homotopy claim, and unindexed earlier work remains possible.
title: The Frucht-graph matching complex is a wedge of twenty three-spheres
